dev_state_rule: Every measured pythia-* state except pythia-2.8b*; all 0.55 <= d < 1 rows.
response: signed Delta L_c(d) = prune_loss_c(d) - dense_loss_c(1.0), in nats

standardization.rule: Natural logs in raw parameter/token units; mean and population std (ddof=0) pooled over training response rows and capabilities, as in v49. Scale=1 for a constant feature. Refit within each LOSO training fold; full-dev values used for prediction.

ridge.A2_interpretation: Per-anchor linear regression with the same fixed ridge as all candidates.

gamma_selection: Minimum unpenalized training SSE after fitting; exact ties use the smaller gamma.

candidate_definitions.A2: Independent beta.phi at each fixed anchor, using only sources measured there. Linear interpolation between adjacent predicted anchors; outside the anchor range, linear extension from the nearest boundary pair. No clipping.
candidate_definitions.strength_only: Unregularized A*((1-d)/0.3)**gamma on all training rows per capability; same gamma grid.
candidate_definitions.median_curve: Median training response at every measured training density. Linear interpolation between adjacent predicted anchors; outside the anchor range, linear extension from the nearest boundary pair. No clipping.

selection_rule: Pick the candidate with the lowest LOSO MAE averaged equally over math, code, and qa, using all held-out pruning rows (row-weighted within capability). If the best two candidates are within 0.02 nats (inclusive), choose among those two the lower-parameter candidate that is continuous and zero at d=1. Parameter order: A1 (4) < power (5) < cont (8) < A2 (20). A2 is piecewise continuous but is not constrained to zero at d=1. Exact MAE ties are ordered by parameter count. Baselines and the off-coarse subset do not select the winner.
